description: Config-driven early search guardrails. Rust evaluates these rules generically and should not hardcode buyer-facing guardrail text.

empty_query.title: Start with the home you are looking for.
empty_query.message: Tell me a city, area, budget, BHK, or the kind of daily life you want.
suggestions: Quiet home for parents near hospital
Avoid water issues near Sarjapur Road

too_short.title: I need a little more to search homes.
too_short.message: Try adding an area, BHK, budget, commute need, school, hospital, or risk you want to avoid.

out_of_scope.title: Are you looking for a home?
out_of_scope.message: I can help with property search, area tradeoffs, commute, schools, hospitals, legal safety, water risk, maintenance, and investment signals.
suggestions: Help me find a family home
Compare Whitefield vs Sarjapur for family
Show homes with low legal and water risk

decision_brief.title: I can help, but this is a decision brief first.
decision_brief.message: Tell me your city, rough budget, monthly rent, and how long you expect to stay. Then I can turn it into a search plan.
suggestions: Buy or rent in Whitefield with 2Cr budget
Investment flat vs renting near office

needs_more_specifics.title: What kind of home should I optimize for?
needs_more_specifics.message: Add one anchor: area, budget, BHK, commute, school, hospital, legal safety, water risk, maintenance, or investment goal.
suggestions: Quiet home for parents near hospital

needs_home_anchor.title: Are you looking for a home?
needs_home_anchor.message: I did not see a home-search anchor. Add an area, budget, BHK, place, or concern and I will search against proof-backed facts.

unsupported_inventory.title: That inventory is outside the current search.
unsupported_inventory.message: OpenEstates is currently tuned for apartments, not {inventory}. I can still help compare apartment options by area, budget, commute, legal risk, water risk, or livability.
suggestions: Quiet apartment for parents near hospital

no_results.title: No proof-backed matches for this search yet.
no_results.message: I understood the home search, but the current evidence set has no matching apartments. Remove one constraint or search by the strongest anchor first.
